units.source_text: 他百无聊赖，也许会自然而然地要去寻找保护色吧，所以他对途中每个地方的风土人情，都有一种本能的敏感，

en.t: Bored and aimless, he may naturally have gone looking for protective coloration; perhaps for that reason he had an instinctive sensitivity to the customs and temper of every place he passed through,

units.source_text: 打山上下来，从这个乡村十分朴实的景致中，马上领略到一种悠闲宁静的气氛。

en.t: Coming down from the mountain, he immediately sensed, in the village's very plain scenery, an atmosphere of leisure and quiet.

units.source_text: 在客栈里一打听，果然，这里是雪国生活最舒适的村庄之一。

en.t: When he asked at the inn, it turned out, as he had thought, that this was one of the most comfortable villages to live in throughout the snow country.

units.source_text: 据说几年前还没通铁路的时候，这里主要是农民的温泉疗养地。

en.t: They said that a few years earlier, before the railway had reached the place, it had mainly been a hot-spring retreat for farmers.

units.source_text: 有艺妓的家，都挂着印有饭馆或红豆汤馆字号的褪了色的门帘。

en.t: The houses with geisha all had faded shop curtains hanging outside, printed with the names of restaurants or sweet red-bean soup shops.

units.source_text: 人们看到那扇被煤烟熏黑的旧式拉门，一定怀疑这种地方居然还会有客上门。

en.t: Seeing those old-fashioned sliding doors blackened by soot, anyone would surely wonder whether customers could really come to a place like this.

units.source_text: 日用杂货铺或粗点心铺也大都只雇佣一个人，这些雇主除了经营店铺外，似乎还兼干庄稼活。

en.t: The general stores and cheap sweet shops mostly employed only one person, and their owners seemed to do farm work as well as run the shop.

units.source_text: 大约她是师傅家的姑娘——一个没有执照的女子，偶尔到宴会上帮帮忙，不会有哪个艺妓挑眼吧。

en.t: She was probably the master's daughter; since she was an unlicensed woman, no geisha would likely object if she occasionally helped out at a banquet.
